spellingFamilies.label: Ashley family
spellingFamilies.rationale: Ashley was one of the defining girl names of the 1980s; manually reviewed respellings chart separately, so conventional tables understate the combined footprint.

spellingFamilies.label: Megan family
spellingFamilies.rationale: Megan, Meghan, and related reviewed spellings coexisted through the decade; combined totals reveal a larger footprint than any single ranking entry.

spellingFamilies.label: Brittany family
spellingFamilies.rationale: Brittany and its respellings rose sharply in the 1980s; conventional rankings split the combined footprint across several entries.

spellingFamilies.label: Kristen family
spellingFamilies.rationale: Kristen/Kristin and rarer reviewed variants are ranked separately by convention; the family view combines their 1980s footprints.

spellingFamilies.label: Courtney family
spellingFamilies.rationale: Courtney is the dominant spelling, but Cortney/Kourtney variants add measurable volume in the 1980s and are ranked separately by convention.

spellingFamilies.label: Caitlin family
spellingFamilies.rationale: Caitlin/Kaitlin-family spellings each chart separately; grouping the reviewed variants shows their combined 1980s footprint.
